transcript: Speaker A: It is cloudy. Cloudy means many clouds. The sun is not clear. It is windy. Windy means strong air is moving. The wind is blowing. It is hot. Hot means high temperature. I feel very warm. It is stormy. Stormy means strong rain and wind. The weather is rough. It is foggy. Foggy means I cannot see clearly. There is mist in the air. It is cool. Cool means a little cold. The weather feels nice. It is cold. Cold means low temperature. I feel very cool.
